checks.detail: Play fresh uninterrupted encounters against the required 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie enemies. Verify multiple spatial clusters, autonomous locomotion, navigation separation, perception, search, flank, cover reservation, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hit reaction and death. Reject static or duplicated enemies, first-frame fire, wall tracking, teleporting, sliding poses, overlapping capsules, doorway deadlocks, frozen groups or damage without a real enemy shot event.
Candidate-owned Godot ERROR blocks remained after the final Tester runtime branch and log probe.

Fail: the successful overlapping sustained-fire probe confirms recoil recovery, six cadence commits, magazine 30 to 24, yaw -15.126 to -20.168, pitch -11.345 to -8.824, trigger released, and unchanged settled viewmodel pose; native mixed audio, no-spread screen-space ballistic agreement, enemy death feedback, and the complete active event-HUD matrix remain unresolved; coverage.baseline.fps_reticle_ballistics.1866fc5e17a5=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.fps_event_hud_presentation.4d419ec755bb=insufficient_evidence;

Fail: accelerated success and failure branches reached authoritative terminal states, but the failure stack remains primitive at world scale, success-result input can leak into Replay, and ordinary end-to-end execution of both terminal paths was not established; coverage.baseline.accelerated_branch_setup.7ee212621d20=insufficient_evidence;

Fail: title, pause, briefing, and failure result have a coherent hierarchy and the slash decoration is removed, but the 5.06-second opening visibly loops under a 10-second cue sheet, loadout remains text-only, the complete gamepad and 200-percent matrix is absent, and success skip leaks into Replay; coverage.baseline.fps_cinematic_narrative_experie.26098f84272d=fail; coverage.baseline.fps_shell_information_presentat.40d0f2cd0a9e=fail;

Fail: coverage.baseline.fps_weapon_audio_integrity.c1c8bc45faa4=fail; coverage.baseline.fps_footstep_integrity.5372f6aa2769=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.environment_component_layers.68addfde8e62=pass; component.background_energy_multiplier=0.8; component.ambient_light_energy=0.85; component.ambient_light_sky_contribution=0.75; component.tonemap_mode=filmic; component.tonemap_exposure=1; component.ssao_enabled=true; component.ssao_radius=1.2; component.ssao_intensity=1.25; component.ssao_power=1.35; component.direct_sun_energy=1.8; candidate.background_energy_multiplier=0.8; candidate.ambient_light_energy=0.85; candidate.ambient_light_sky_contribution=0.75; candidate.tonemap_mode=filmic; candidate.tonemap_exposure=1; candidate.ssao_enabled=true; candidate.ssao_radius=1.2; candidate.ssao_intensity=1.25; candidate.ssao_power=1.35; candidate.direct_sun_energy=1.8; bounded source review confirms exact component parity in scripts/main.gd and scenes/arena_foundation.tscn, shadows and SSAO enabled, two cloud sheets directly bound to the byte-identical clouds.gdshader SHA 2151c01838888f47cb399a7d4a9bcec630863b672d2fe5d5b9b2e458fc2d4b7d, and a camera/sun-bound flare using the byte-identical sun_flare.gd SHA 6aae993abf30e8940bfe5a9cede2439958064c2b6142b14f5f116e43c3eeab24; gameplay nevertheless remains visibly washed, the product trigger_fire AUTO adapter routes a 460 ms player report instead of the retained component envelope, and weapon and footstep mixed-output onset and tails remain unqualified.

Fail: candidate-attributable runtime errors were not observed, sampled cleanup returned to zero, mouse look remained captured during sustained fire, and recoil recovered without a process restart, but llvmpipe at a nonmatching target resolution averaged about 133 ms per frame and cannot satisfy the required hardware-backed 1920x1080 three-cycle qualification.

Issue one integrated verdict for the complete Fusepoint vertical slice across world, movement, both weapons, 18 enemies, A/B capture, C defusal, HUD/minimap, story, audio/VFX, ordinary death, success, detonation failure, menus, accessibility and restart stability. Require continuous current-candidate evidence and name the highest-impact blocker; source inspection, labels, beauty frames or self-reported completion are insufficient.

required_criteria.requirement: Inspect continuous motion for player weapons/hands and all visible enemy states. Require stable roots and sockets, weapon-hand contact, locomotion without foot sliding, readable aim/fire/hurt/death transitions, no T-pose or transform-only substitute, and third-person victory dance framing that faces the user after combat freezes.

Bind state logs, continuous frames and audio for player/enemy fire, near miss, material impact, player damage, enemy hit, kill and death. Require synchronized muzzle flash, animation, recoil, projectile/tracer or pellet result, occlusion, impact VFX/audio, red edge damage mask, camera response and a restrained right-side yellow kill notification such as 'YOU KILLED' without opaque cards or debug labels. Enemy death must have clear animation and sound feedback.

Execute both terminal paths from ordinary gameplay. Success must atomically defuse before zero, freeze combat, move to a safe third-person camera, play the character victory dance, show score/time/rank and offer replay/home. Failure must atomically detonate at zero, set health to zero once, disable combat, layer flash/fire/sparks/debris/shockwave/dust/light/audio, shake then lower the camera, expand and decay the red damage mask, play the failure video or still fallback, and offer retry/home without a generic Game Over label.

Navigate title, briefing/loading, loadout, gameplay, pause, settings, ordinary death recovery, success result, failure result and replay using keyboard/mouse and gamepad. Require coherent grounded typography and transparent AAA-style information hierarchy, visible focus/hover/pressed states, truthful paused HUD snapshot, readable 200 percent UI scale, subtitles, motion reduction and persisted settings. Reject default fonts, card grids, large opaque color blocks, deep-blue borders, slash-slash labels, debug text, focus traps or direct boot into gameplay.

Review daylight environment lighting, neutral exposure, contact shadows and event-driven audio/VFX across the complete mission. Require readable real materials, distinct weapon/mechanical/footstep/impact/enemy/objective/bomb/dialogue/ambience/music layers, bounded effects with world scale and surface response, and no clipping. Reject overexposure, bloom flicker, missing geometry during camera motion, darkness/fog/post effects hiding weak assets, silent kills or one sound/effect reused for unrelated events.

Run the complete mission at 1920x1080 after initial load with raw frame-time samples and repeat restart/replay three times. Target 60 FPS and no sustained explosion dip below 45 FPS for three frames. Reject fatal Godot errors, crash, soft lock, input/camera/collision escape, duplicated enemies or events, unbounded particles/audio/corpses/signals, navigation deadlock, texture shimmer, disappearing map surfaces or state drift after restart.
